title: Mulat Media
summary: A student journalism site with article browsing, a Wordle game and an editorial workflow where staff submit articles that the Editor-in-Chief approves.

nodes.label: Reader
nodes.detail: A visitor reading news, playing Wordle and liking the site.

nodes.label: Staff writer
nodes.detail: An approved staff member who submits and edits their own articles.

nodes.label: Editor / admin
nodes.detail: The Editor-in-Chief or developer admin who reviews and approves posts.

nodes.label: Homepage
nodes.detail: Breaking banner, hero carousel and latest articles by category.

nodes.label: Category pages
nodes.detail: Articles listing plus the six section pages (news, opinion, sports, etc.).

nodes.label: Article page
nodes.detail: Single article reader driven by the URL query.

nodes.label: About and members
nodes.detail: About, mission, vision, core values, acknowledgement and staff profile pages.

nodes.label: Staff login
nodes.detail: Email and password sign-in with email OTP verification for staff.

nodes.label: Submit article
nodes.detail: Form for writing an article, tagging a category and uploading a photo.

nodes.label: Review queue
nodes.detail: Editors approve or send back pending articles; writers manage their own.

nodes.label: Wordle game
nodes.detail: Daily and practice Wordle with midnight reset and local persistence.

nodes.label: Stats widget
nodes.detail: Draggable floating visit and like counter.

nodes.label: Newsroom client
nodes.detail: Browser controller for auth, article CRUD and photo upload against the API.

nodes.label: Article renderer
nodes.detail: Fetches and renders a single article by ID.

nodes.label: /api/newsroom
nodes.detail: Articles CRUD, member lookup, eligibility check, config and signed photo upload URLs.

nodes.label: /api/auth proxy
nodes.detail: Same-origin proxy to Neon Auth for sign-in, session, token and password routes.

nodes.label: /api/media
nodes.detail: Streams article photos from R2 with caching and key validation.

nodes.label: Staff permissions
nodes.detail: Server-owned staff allowlist and rules for who can manage which article.

nodes.label: Neon Postgres
nodes.detail: Articles and profiles tables plus the Neon Auth user table.

nodes.label: Neon Auth
nodes.detail: Identity provider issuing sessions, JWTs and email OTP codes.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2
nodes.detail: Object storage for article photos, uploaded via signed URLs.

nodes.label: Abacus counter API
nodes.detail: Third-party counter service behind the visit and like numbers.

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.detail: Hosts the static public/ build and the serverless API functions.
